sections.text_helper: Section 26.6.2 "Validation conditions" in chapter 26 (True random number generator (RNG)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 783.
sections.section_content:
The RNG true random number generator has been tested in the following conditions:
• RNG clock rng_clk = 48MHz, with CED bit cleared in RNG_CR.
• Configurations are described in Table199 and Table200. Only configuration A can be
certified NIST SP800-90B. Refer to Table201 to select the best configuration for the
application.
• Configuration B or C can be used when configuration A is not present in AN4230, or is
not flagged as certified.
[Table 199. RNG configurations]
[Table 200. Additional health test configurations]
[Table 201. Configuration selection]
For details on data collection and the running of statistical test suites refer to AN4230
“Introduction to random number generation validation using the NIST statistical test suite for
STM32 MCUs and MPUs”, available on www.st.com.
